# Grammarly
> AI writing assistance that helps people and teams write clearly, effectively, and securely across apps and websites.

Grammarly provides grammar, spelling, clarity, tone, and generative AI assistance for individuals, students, and businesses. Its products span browser, desktop, mobile, document editing, AI agents, and enterprise-focused communication support.

## Core Platform
- [Grammarly: Free AI Writing Assistance](https://www.grammarly.com): Main product overview for AI-powered writing help across apps, sites, and workflows.
- [Features](https://www.grammarly.com/features): Overview of grammar, clarity, tone, rewrite, and productivity features.
- [AI at Grammarly](https://www.grammarly.com/ai): Explains Grammarly’s AI capabilities, use cases, and product approach.
- [AI Assistant](https://www.grammarly.com/go-ai-assistant): Personal AI assistant for drafting, rewriting, and context-aware writing support.
- [AI Agents](https://www.grammarly.com/ai-agents): Directory and overview of task-specific AI agents for communication workflows.
- [Trust & Security](https://www.grammarly.com/trust): Security, privacy, compliance, and responsible AI information.

## Writing Products
- [Docs](https://www.grammarly.com/docs): AI document editor for drafting, revising, and collaborating on documents.
- [Browser](https://www.grammarly.com/browser): Browser extension for writing assistance on websites and web apps.
- [Desktop](https://www.grammarly.com/desktop): Desktop application for writing support across native apps and browsers.
- [Mobile](https://www.grammarly.com/mobile): Mobile keyboard and app experience for writing on phones and tablets.
- [Languages](https://www.grammarly.com/languages): Information about multilingual writing support and supported languages.

## Solutions by Audience
- [Professionals](https://www.grammarly.com/professionals): Product experience tailored for individual professionals and everyday work writing.
- [Students](https://www.grammarly.com/students): Writing support for essays, assignments, citations, and academic communication.
- [Teams & Businesses](https://www.grammarly.com/business): Business offering for teams with shared writing standards and AI assistance.
- [Enterprise](https://www.grammarly.com/business/enterprise): Enterprise-grade deployment, governance, security, and large-scale team support.

## Business Use Cases
- [Customer Support](https://www.grammarly.com/business/customer-support): Communication assistance for support teams handling customer conversations at scale.
- [Marketing](https://www.grammarly.com/business/marketing): Brand-consistent writing support for campaigns, messaging, and content teams.
- [IT](https://www.grammarly.com/business/it): IT-focused information on deployment, administration, and secure adoption.
- [Sales](https://www.grammarly.com/business/sales): Writing assistance for outreach, follow-ups, and sales communication workflows.
- [HR](https://www.grammarly.com/business/hr): Support for internal communication, recruiting, and people operations writing.
